correctness.rationale: The deletion bijection preserves genus because adjacent pair corresponds to a fixed point of the face permutation; counting disjoint cycle edges gives the exact factorial identity including k=n. The 2011 Harer--Zagier GF yields the exact genus mean increments and parity covariance; the known 2011 normal genus limit and uniformly bounded factorial moments establish independent Poisson--normal convergence. An independently implemented matching enumerator passed 125 exact integer/rational assertions at n=2..7; finite enumeration is corroboration, not proof of asymptotics.
